apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: hellonode-deployment
  labels:
    hello: node
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      hello: node
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        hello: node
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: hellonode-container
          image: registry.k8s.io/e2e-test-images/agnhost:2.39
          command: ["/agnhost"]
          args: ["netexec", "--http-port=8080", "--udp-port=8081"]
